topic: Kawaki kidnaps Kashin Koji to force another look at a future that once showed him killing Boruto
title: Kawaki Just Kidnapped The Man Who's Seen Him Kill Boruto
description: In Two Blue Vortex chapter 37, Kawaki finally snaps and drags Kashin Koji straight to Amado. That's terrifying, because Koji's Ten Directions once showed a future where Kawaki kills Boruto, and Kawaki knows it. So what is Koji hiding now that he asked to be cut off from Boruto?
comment: Is Koji hiding a way to save Sarada, or a future where Boruto doesn't make it? Pick one.

lines.text: Kawaki just kidnapped the one man who's seen him kill Boruto.

shot.fallback: white-haired young man with a glowing arm mark, furious expression, anime style

lines.text: That man is Kashin Koji, Jiraiya's clone.

shot.fallback: grizzled older shinobi with spiky white hair and a cybernetic eye

lines.text: Amado gave him a power called Ten Directions.

shot.fallback: calm scientist in a high-tech underground lab, glowing monitors

lines.text: It lets him see every possible future.

shot.fallback: shinobi's eye glowing with fractured visions of the future

lines.text: And one of those futures was Kawaki killing Boruto.

shot.fallback: two young shinobi clashing in a dark, ominous silhouette

lines.text: That memory never left Kawaki alone.

shot.fallback: young shinobi standing alone, troubled expression, dim lighting

lines.text: In chapter 37, Code took Sarada right in front of them.

shot.fallback: shadowy tattooed figure seizing a young kunoichi, chaotic battlefield

lines.text: Koji saw it coming and still couldn't stop it.

shot.fallback: grizzled shinobi with a shocked, helpless expression

lines.text: So Kawaki snapped and dragged Koji straight to Amado.

shot.fallback: furious young shinobi gripping an older man by the collar

lines.text: He wanted one more look into the future.

shot.fallback: young shinobi shouting a demand, intense close up

lines.text: But Ten Directions doesn't work like that.

shot.fallback: shinobi straining as visions flicker and refuse to settle

lines.text: It shows Koji whatever it wants, not what Kawaki needs.

shot.fallback: shattered glass-like visions floating around a shinobi's head

lines.text: So Kawaki didn't get the answer he came for.

shot.fallback: young shinobi clenching his fist in frustration

lines.text: And Koji still asked to be cut off from Boruto.

shot.fallback: shinobi speaking quietly into a small communication device

lines.text: Which means he saw something he isn't ready to share.

shot.fallback: shinobi's face half in shadow, unreadable expression

lines.text: Maybe it's how Sarada comes home.

shot.fallback: young kunoichi with sharingan eyes, faint hopeful light

lines.text: Or maybe it's how Boruto doesn't.

shot.fallback: young shinobi silhouette against a darkening sky

lines.text: Because Kawaki just kidnapped the one man who already knows the ending...

shot.fallback: white-haired young man with a glowing arm mark, furious expression, anime style
